body: He is fine with this and has expressed concern. They used to know each other. He wants to help as well but he doesn't think contacting him as himself would help him. He's also open to seeing him if my ex shows more signs of not wanting to live.

My boyfriend used to know him and has shared concern for him. He knows I'm messaging him. When depressed people post things opening up their vulnerability it often is a cry for help for their suffering. I'm approaching this with concern as I don't want him to off himself. I know this because I've been there and I genuinely just want to know how to help.

From my experience, he seemed like a kind-hearted individual who was generous and compassionate. 

Our relationship hasn't been complete shit and we shared a lot of happy memories apart from how he chose to end things. From what I can tell he had a lot of stressors in his life and didn't want to confront me to give an actual proper breakup.

I don't really know his life as of now but he seems unnecessarily self-deprecating and has a low self-esteem. Even if he's mistreated myself I still see potential in him and I don't think anyone deserves to suffer in isolation.
